<script>
(function (w) {
  var pixel = '{{CONST - Meta Pixel ID}}';
  if (w.cups1MetaPixel !== pixel || !w.fbq) return;
  var id = '{{DLV - items.0.item_id}}';
  var quantity = Number('{{DLV - items.0.quantity}}');
  var currency = '{{DLV - currency}}';
  var value = Number('{{DLV - value}}');
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(id) || !/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(currency) ||
      !isFinite(value) || value < 0 || quantity < 1 || quantity % 1 !== 0) return;
  w.fbq('trackSingle', pixel, 'AddToCart', {
    content_ids: [id],
    contents: [{id: id, quantity: quantity}],
    content_type: 'product',
    value: value,
    currency: currency
  });
})(window);
</script>

<script>
(function (w, d) {
  var id = '{{CONST - Meta Pixel ID}}';
  if (!/^\d{8,25}$/.test(id)) return;
  if (w.cups1MetaPixel === id) {
    if (w.fbq && w.cups1MetaRevoked) {
      w.fbq('consent', 'grant');
      w.cups1MetaRevoked = false;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (/^\/(?:wp-admin|wp-login\.php|my-account|checkout)(?:\/|$)/i.test(w.location.pathname) || w.location.hash) return;
  var safeQuery = true;
  new URLSearchParams(w.location.search).forEach(function (value, key) {
    if (!/^(?:utm_(?:source|medium|campaign|id|term|content|source_platform|creative_format|marketing_tactic)|fbclid|gtm_debug)$/.test(key)) safeQuery = false;
  });
  if (!safeQuery) return;
  if (!w.fbq) {
    var queue = function () {
      if (queue.callMethod) queue.callMethod.apply(queue, arguments);
      else queue.queue.push(arguments);
    };
    w.fbq = queue;
    if (!w._fbq) w._fbq = queue;
    queue.push = queue;
    queue.loaded = true;
    queue.version = '2.0';
    queue.queue = [];
    var script = d.createElement('script');
    script.async = true;
    script.src = 'https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js';
    d.head.appendChild(script);
  }
  w.fbq('consent', 'grant');
  w.fbq('set', 'autoConfig', false, id);
  w.fbq('init', id);
  w.cups1MetaPixel = id;
  w.fbq('trackSingle', id, 'PageView');
})(window, document);
</script>

<script>
(function (w, d) {
  function emit(event, payload) {
    w.dataLayer = w.dataLayer || [];
    payload.event = event;
    w.dataLayer.push(payload);
  }

  function displayPrice(amount, minorUnit) {
    if (amount == null || amount === '' || !Number.isInteger(minorUnit) || minorUnit < 0 || minorUnit > 6) return NaN;
    return Number(amount) / Math.pow(10, minorUnit);
  }

  function viewProduct() {
    var product = d.querySelector('[data-product-detail]');
    if (!product) return;
    var heading = d.getElementById(product.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'));
    var cartButton = product.querySelector('[data-catalog-cart-item]');
    var post = /(?:^|\s)postid-(\d+)(?:\s|$)/.exec(d.body.className);
    var id = cartButton && (cartButton.dataset.cartId || cartButton.dataset.catalogCartItem) || post && post[1];
    var name = heading && heading.textContent.trim();
    if (/^\d+$/.test(id || '') && name) emit('cups1_product_view', { items: [{ item_id: id, item_name: name }] });
  }

  function readCart(event) {
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart', { credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(function (response) { return response.ok ? response.json() : null; })
      .then(function (cart) {
        if (!cart || !Array.isArray(cart.items) || !cart.items.length) return;
        var totals = cart.totals || {};
        var currency = totals.currency_code;
        var value = displayPrice(totals.total_items, totals.currency_minor_unit);
        if (!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(currency || '') || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return;
        var items = cart.items.map(function (entry) {
          var prices = entry.prices || {};
          var price = displayPrice(prices.price, prices.currency_minor_unit);
          if (!/^\d+$/.test(String(entry.id)) || !entry.name || !Number.isInteger(entry.quantity) || entry.quantity < 1 ||
              !Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0 || prices.currency_code !== currency) return null;
          return { item_id: String(entry.id), item_name: entry.name, quantity: entry.quantity, price: price };
        });
        if (items.every(Boolean)) emit(event, { currency: currency, value: value, items: items });
      }).catch(function () { /* Measurement never interrupts the storefront. */ });
  }

  function track() {
    var path = w.location.pathname;
    if (/^\/product\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('single-product')) viewProduct();
    else if (/^\/cart\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('woocommerce-cart')) readCart('cups1_cart_view');
    else if (/^\/checkout\/?$/.test(path) && d.body.classList.contains('woocommerce-checkout')) readCart('cups1_checkout_start');
  }

  if (d.readyState === 'complete') track();
  else w.addEventListener('load', track, { once: true });
})(window, document);
</script>
